Package neqsim.thermo.phase

Class PitzerTemperatureFunction

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.phase.PitzerTemperatureFunction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class PitzerTemperatureFunction extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable PHREEQC-compatible six-coefficient temperature function for a Pitzer parameter.

The function is evaluated on the absolute-temperature scale as a0 + a1(1/T - 1/Tr) + a2 ln(T/Tr) + a3(T - Tr) + a4(T^2 - Tr^2) + a5(1/T^2 - 1/Tr^2). It follows the public-domain PHREEQC calc_pitz_param convention and performs no unit or standard-state conversion.

  • Method Details

    • fromKaasa1998

      public static PitzerTemperatureFunction fromKaasa1998(double[] coefficients)
      Creates a temperature function from Kaasa (1998) Appendix F coefficient order.

      Appendix F equation (F.1) lists coefficients as [a,b,c,d,e,f] for the constant, (T-Tr), (T^2-Tr^2), (1/T-1/Tr), ln(T/Tr), and (1/T^2-1/Tr^2) terms. The internal PHREEQC order is therefore [a,d,e,b,c,f]. This factory performs only that permutation; it does not copy a source table or convert units, standard states, or parameter families.

      Parameters:
      coefficients - exactly six finite coefficients in Kaasa Appendix F order
      Returns:
      immutable temperature function in the internal PHREEQC order
